features.title: Caller voice settings · exploratory task outcomes
features.description: Four prompted TTS voice settings, six providers and default-voice baselines. Original accents unverified. Task results with recovered assistant excerpts; original caller audio unavailable.

features.title: Standardised-v3 bake-off · six providers
features.description: Completed assessment of 720 runs: six providers on the same standardised-v3 prompt, 40 scenarios, three repetitions, judges off. No clear quality winner; GPT-Realtime has one failed run so its overall score is not computed.

features.title: Accent panel · ElevenLabs caller voices
features.description: Six tasks, six providers, three repeats in a default voice and four ElevenLabs library voices (540 conversations). Exploratory; library accent tags are unverified and the default voice uses a different speech engine.

features.title: Standard-prompt bake-off · five providers plus carry-over
features.description: Completed assessment of 720 runs: five providers on standardised prompts plus GPT-Live carried over from 28 October (advanced prompts, not like for like), 40 scenarios, three repetitions. No clear quality winner.

features.title: Latency benchmark · how long a caller waits
features.description: Six providers on their own end-of-speech detection, 497 timed turns over four sessions on 31 October. Latency only: separate from the quality bake-offs and not comparable with their earlier latency figures.

features.title: Explore the executive briefing
features.description: How we engineered the voice harness, how the tests work, and the evidence behind the business decision.

features.title: Voice conversation · AI transcript assessment
features.description: All 144 conversations scored for wording and behaviour, with scenario shortlists, source quotes and risk flags. Audio delivery unscored.

features.title: Voice conversation · quick business review
features.description: Provider and model identities visible, with six scenarios, all 144 recordings, transcripts and downloadable ratings.

features.title: Voice conversation · blind listening study
features.description: Common against provider-tuned prompts in 144 three-turn conversations, with British female assistant and British male caller voices. Ratings pending.

features.title: Fair bake-off · final re-score
features.description: Earlier 720-cell assessment of six providers. Re-scored evidence; no calls were rerun. Different setup from the latest standard-prompt bake-off.

features.title: Fair bake-off · original assessment
features.description: Original scoring retained for provenance. Use the final re-score when reviewing this earlier experiment.

features.title: Advanced bake-off · corrected assessment
features.description: Earlier 600-cell experiment, with corrected latency and task-completion scoring. Different setup from the latest bake-off.

features.title: GPT-Live 1 · single-model evaluation
features.description: Forty synthetic scenarios with assurance checks, task completion, latency and scoped costs.

features.title: GPT-Live 1 · listening room
features.description: Selected assistant speech with audio players and transcripts. Use the evaluation for measured latency.
